evals.prompt: 根据当前仓库里的 React 管理后台源码，提炼现有视觉语言并输出到 ops-design 文件夹。需要能指导后续订单列表和退款详情页的实现。
evals.expected_output: Creates ops-design/DESIGN.md, preview.html, and preview-dark.html; infers a backend-admin archetype from source evidence and demonstrates dense operational components in both themes.

evals.prompt: 这是我们健身记录 App 的三张截图。帮我整理一套可落地的设计规范，没有指定品牌字体，输出默认目录即可。
evals.expected_output: Creates DESIGN/DESIGN.md, preview.html, and preview-dark.html; marks font and unseen-state assumptions, and presents a touch-safe mobile app specimen rather than a compressed desktop layout.

evals.prompt: 为一个叫 ForgeFlow 的 AI 视频生成工具做视觉设计规范。用户输入提示词、选择模型和画幅、等待生成、比较版本并下载。风格要专业、偏创意工作室，不要俗套的 AI 紫色渐变。输出到 brand-system。
evals.expected_output: Creates brand-system/DESIGN.md, preview.html, and preview-dark.html; chooses the AIGC archetype and documents a distinctive generation workspace, relevant states, and non-generic light/dark visual systems.
